name: Sweden — Swedish parties
intro: compare it with Swedish political parties
inclusion_note: The test includes the main national parties of Sweden: those represented in the parliament (Riksdag) and those with a significant national following. Positions are the team's estimates and are open to review.
hemicycle_note: Seats in the parliament (Riksdag) after the 2022 election, arranged left to right. Approximate. 349 members. A more recent election is not yet reflected in these seats; the party list includes parties that are strong in current polls.

V.name: Vänsterpartiet
V.priorities: Welfare state, Affordable housing, Workers' rights and wages
V.description: Left Party, which defends the welfare state and opposed NATO membership.

MP.name: Miljöpartiet de gröna
MP.description: Green Party, focused on climate and a humane migration policy.

S.name: Socialdemokraterna
S.priorities: Welfare state, Security and law and order, Workers' rights and wages
S.description: Social Democrats, Sweden's largest party, which built the Swedish welfare model.

C.name: Centerpartiet
C.priorities: Regions and rural services, Small business and entrepreneurs, Climate action
C.description: Centre Party, a liberal party with agrarian roots.

L.name: Liberalerna
L.priorities: Education, Deeper European integration, Civil liberties
L.description: Liberals, a classical-liberal party in the right-leaning government.

Volt.name: Volt Sverige
Volt.priorities: Deeper European integration, Climate action, Digital innovation, Democratic reform
Volt.description: National chapter of Volt Europa, the first pan-European party. All chapters share one programme: a federal and more democratic EU, evidence-based policy, a market economy with a strong welfare state, and the digital and climate transitions. Volt has the same positions in every country in this test.

M.name: Moderaterna
M.priorities: Security and law and order, Lower taxes, Reducing immigration
M.description: Moderate Party of Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson, leading a centre-right government supported by the Sweden Democrats.

KD.name: Kristdemokraterna
KD.priorities: Public healthcare, Traditional family values, Security and law and order
KD.description: Christian Democrats, part of the government.

SD.name: Sverigedemokraterna
SD.priorities: Reducing immigration, Security and law and order, Nuclear energy
SD.description: Sweden Democrats, a national-conservative party that became the second largest in 2022 and supports the government on migration and crime.
